details:
There should be some advanced movie camera mode... like vrclens is good, but it's just avatar addon and suffer from desynchronization. Like if move dron in one possition and when i want move that back... then it kinda shift on one side and continues shifting more. And also i seen some vids on TikTok there clearly some users using vrchat camera mods. I want do these cool orbit shots... or shots where camera move on predefined curve too. But i want do that legally, i dont wanna risk ban. So i am writing this.. as there is not enough stuff for vid makers. Its definitely possible to make movie in VRC but its harder then it should be... if you wanna use like dron shots , orbit or do some excact camera movement without someone assisting you with that.  It's not possible without vrclens or camera mods.
So could be cool if here was like option in QM settings where everyone could turn on movie camera mode.... because we don't wanna confuse people with something like this from start... or we want?
There is so much stuff what could be used, so it's probably better to make whole new quickmenu tab for that.
For example:
- Spawning drons (3-5)
- Maybe dron controls as separate floating panel?
- Spawning cameras (3-5) which do not despawn if you add another
- Spawning camera monitoring panel (like place where you can see all your cameras and can choose which will be streamed to vrc desktop view )
- Spawning camera management panel , where you could remotely change settings for every spawned camera, could be merged with camera monitoring panel
- Passing control over one of your camera to one user ... or assing cameras to the users.
- Passing user control over your camera monitoring panel.
- Spawning path control panel.. where you could take green pen from floating stand ... and draw line in the air where with second red pen you could add dot to the line. 
And make sectors, where then can be deffined for each sector camera movement speed and camera modes like ''fast slide in one sector .. slowed in next sector and in the last sector switched to track avatar in front'' and also some tool with what you can straighten sectors into straight line, or just modify line into curve by adding yellow dots on the line and then just moving with dot in one way... up and down and then left or right.
-Option to add box/line triggers (with custom opacity and custom size) which could switch to the next camera or just into another path camera pattern which you recorded previously.
- Option to set offset of whole camera path, or place that path somewhere else just pointing on that path with tool and then move it to the desired place.
- Option to save camera path on HDD as file. and use that path later. Or share that 
with users online.
- Option to switch from the camera path control panel.. to recording path where instead of drawing you could record camera movement or dron movement and then slightly edit that movement
 It sound like i want too much but some tools for vid making could be good... currently there is only photo camera which have bunch things for photo making but not for video making.. where you need use vrclens and its not pc resource friendly. It's big fps hit until you find some compromis between quality and watchability with vrclens.
title: Functions for content creators (for tiktok/youtube vids)
